palette: C_SYS (AR40's C, the system panel), as the foe cards

tray.where: centred on the phone's middle; its foot 12 above the dock's top (95 above the phone's foot)
tray.plate: the kit's panel (Config.UIKit's slices, as the foe cards): PanelShadow under it (pad 16), PanelFill tinted C's panel #34606C to #2A4E5A, opaque (the world never shows through the tray), PanelEdge tinted C's edge #E2CFA4
tray.point: HomePoint, its anchor on the tray's foot at the phone's middle

layout.headingNote: the mark an ImageLabel markBox square, its middle at `mark`: Inventory's HomeMarkInventory, Equipment's Config.Hud PageForge, tinted C's light #F0E2C4; the group's name 14 points, bold, C's text #FFF6E2, its capitals' middle at `word`, centred. No plate
layout.tileNote: each tile's images laid in its box (left, top, width, height), an image with a Pad in that box grown by its Pad on every side, bottom to top: Glow (pressed), Fill, Edge, Glint (at rest). Its icon an ImageLabel iconBox square, its middle at `icon`: the page's icon, Config.Hud's PageOverview, PageKit, PageItems (Inventory), PageStars, PageForge (Reinforce), PageJewels and PageWarEmblems; Settings' HomeMarkSettings. Tinted C's light #F0E2C4 at rest, C's ink #1E3238 pressed. Its word 14 points, bold, centred, its capitals' middle at `word`: C's text #FFF6E2 at rest, C's ink pressed

rule.note: a 1 point line between the rows and Settings, C's edge #E2CFA4 at BackgroundTransparency 0.4: a Frame 1 wide and 104.0 high, its middle at `middle`, Rotation 11.31 (clockwise, its top to the right)

layoutNote: measured on the smallest phone (568 by 320); the tray keeps its size on every phone, centred

states.rest: Fill tinted C's button, Edge C's facet at 0.45, Glint shown, icon and word light
states.pressed: Glow shown under, Fill C's lit, Edge C's light, Glint hidden, icon and word ink; the press's squeeze is Config.Hud.Motion.Press, as every press

dim.note: the world dims under the tray, eased out; the dock stays lit above the dim (its rect: 100 points each side of the middle, 83 up from the foot)

motion.note: open: the tray grows from GrowFrom of its size to 1 about the Home tile's top middle (the phone's middle, 83 up from the foot) in Grow seconds, a Back ease of GrowBack, and fades in in Fade. step: into a screen and Back, as AR43's record says. Seeds for Config.Hud.Motion

HomeTileFill.tint: at rest, C's button #447480 at its top to #366270 at its foot (a UIGradient); pressed, C's lit #F0E2C4 to #DCCBA6
HomeTileFill.use: a button tile in Inventory's and Equipment's rows: its body. Sliced at Cut (left, top, right, foot), its slanted ends inside the end slices: drawn at its own height (52), it stretches along only. Its box is its foot's width plus 10.4.

HomeTileEdge.tint: at rest, C's facet #8FC4C8 at ImageTransparency 0.45; pressed, C's light #F0E2C4
HomeTileEdge.use: a button tile in Inventory's and Equipment's rows: its hairline, over the body. Its box is the tile's with Pad on every side: the line sits on the tile's outline, half outside. Sliced as the tile, at its own height (54).

HomeTileGlint.tint: C's glint #FFF6E2 at ImageTransparency 0.65; at rest only
HomeTileGlint.use: a button tile in Inventory's and Equipment's rows: the light along its top, over the hairline. Its box is the tile's with Pad on every side: the line sits on the tile's outline, half outside. Sliced as the tile, at its own height (54).

HomeTileGlow.tint: C's light #F0E2C4 at ImageTransparency 0.6; pressed only, under the body
HomeTileGlow.use: a button tile in Inventory's and Equipment's rows: the press's glow. Its box is the tile's with Pad on every side. Sliced as the tile, at its own height (68).

HomeTallFill.tint: at rest, C's button #447480 at its top to #366270 at its foot (a UIGradient); pressed, C's lit #F0E2C4 to #DCCBA6
HomeTallFill.use: Settings' tile, both rows high: its body. Never sliced: drawn at its own size, its foot 72 wide and its top 22.8 right of its foot.

HomeTallEdge.tint: at rest, C's facet #8FC4C8 at ImageTransparency 0.45; pressed, C's light #F0E2C4
HomeTallEdge.use: Settings' tile, both rows high: its hairline, over the body. Its box is the tile's with Pad on every side: the line sits on the tile's outline, half outside. Never sliced.

HomeTallGlint.tint: C's glint #FFF6E2 at ImageTransparency 0.65; at rest only
HomeTallGlint.use: Settings' tile, both rows high: the light along its top, over the hairline. Its box is the tile's with Pad on every side: the line sits on the tile's outline, half outside. Never sliced.

HomeTallGlow.tint: C's light #F0E2C4 at ImageTransparency 0.6; pressed only, under the body
HomeTallGlow.use: Settings' tile, both rows high: the press's glow. Its box is the tile's with Pad on every side. Never sliced.

HomePoint.use: the point toward the Home tile, in its own colours (C's panel's foot #2A4E5A, C's edge #E2CFA4), never tinted. Its anchor on the tray's foot at the phone's middle, laid over the plate, so the point opens into it

HomeMarkSettings.tint: at rest, C's light #F0E2C4; pressed, C's ink #1E3238
HomeMarkSettings.use: Settings' cog, drawn 30 high in its 32 point box: on Settings' tile at 26 high (its box 27.7)

HomeMarkInventory.use: Inventory's mark, a shard with its crease cut through, drawn 30 high in its 32 point box: in Inventory's heading at 18 high (its box 19.2)
